Hi guys any idea what might be going on with the fan?

Javier M. (phone hidden)
Note to the team: Routed to Hal.

Hi guys!

Any chance something can be done with the fan? It’s not running as it
should.

I appreciate your help

Javier M. (phone hidden)
Handed to the team · Sending a replacement fan part is not something I can do myself.

Hi Javier,

Yes, something can be done, and you should not have to live with it. The readings are clear: your fan is turning about 950 RPM short of what the same command produces on the identical unit, and that is why your hashboard sits several degrees hotter. A fan that undershoots a 100 percent command like that does not come back with a firmware or settings change, so the sensible fix is a new fan on that unit rather than more testing.

I have put that in front of the team with your serial and both sets of readings attached to your order, so nobody has to ask you for any of it again. They are offline tonight and pick this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you right here in this thread.

In the meantime you can keep running it, just give it as much open air around the intake as you can and keep an eye on the hashboard temperature.

Thanks for doing all that testing, Javier, it is the reason this was easy to pin down.

Sarah

Hi!

Yes both units were set to 100%.

Thanks !

Javier M. (phone hidden)

Hi Javier,

Thanks for confirming, that is the answer Georges needed. Both units commanded to 100 percent, same firmware, and yours still sitting around 950 RPM lower is exactly the comparison that matters.

Georges has it and picks this up today from 10am Eastern, and his reply comes to you right here in this thread. Nothing else is needed from you in the meantime.

Appreciate you sticking with it, Javier.

Sarah

Hi Team any update?
Thanks
Javier M.
(phone hidden)
Handed to the team · Georges asked Javier to confirm both units were at 100 percent, Javier confirmed

Hi Javier,

No update yet, and I am sorry you have had to ask again. Your answer to Georges went in on November 2 and nothing has come back to you since, which is longer than it should have taken.

I have put it back in front of him this morning with the whole picture attached: your serial, both sets of readings, the matching firmware, and your confirmation that both units were commanded to 100 percent. The open question is just the replacement fan, and nothing more is needed from you to decide it.

He is offline over the weekend and picks this up Monday from 10am Eastern, and his answer comes to you right here in this thread.

Thanks for your patience with it, Javier.

Sarah
